prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 2×1 grid. Redraw only cell 2 (the transparent area). Keep cell 1 exactly as it is, and match its style, colours and fine detail.

The faults in cell 2: the light well showed its inner walls with rows of windows, and each dormer was drawn as a little house with a gable wall and a window, both seen from the side. Looking straight down no wall is seen: the light well is a dark rectangular opening about 10 × 6 m showing only its rim, and a dormer is a small roof shape about 1.5 m wide (about 22 px here). The chimney stacks were drawn about 2.4 m across, four times their true size: a chimney is about 0.6 m, about 9 px here.

For the redrawn cell, trace the outline in image 2 exactly, keep its proportions, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, and keep the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside it. Details at true size: this block stands next to cars 4 m long (about 58 px here). No text.
